statusDetail: Coverage complete: all 58 catalog checks have conclusive outcomes.

page.notes: Public adult-video catalog. Representative coverage includes listing, archive, video detail, contact form and 404 recovery. Search, pagination, every category/tag, account completion and destructive form submission were not exercised because their templates/side effects were redundant or unsafe for an external report-only audit.

paths.description: Homepage listing: entry point, navigation, filters, responsive grid, global security/performance and crawler behavior.
Indian Porn category: representative listing/archive template; other category and tag archives were not duplicated because they share this template.
Representative video detail and primary watch journey, including embedded player and advertising.
Contact/support form: representative form and recovery/input-assistance journey.
Unknown URL: representative HTTP/navigation recovery state.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-emulation screenshot is pixel-identical to the light capture; computed html color-scheme is normal and body remains #eee.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces/text with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no authored view-transition rules and this multi-page site exposes many route changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and intentional shared transition names with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to scroll state
findings.evidence: DOM and screenshots show static page chrome; no scroll-state container/query or progress indicator was found on long 2,743px and 3,779px pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sticky scroll-state-aware chrome or a lightweight progress/return affordance on long listings.

findings.summary: Advertising crowds the primary video
findings.evidence: The mobile detail screenshot places a 320×117 phone-sex ad directly under a 340×191 player, consuming substantial first-screen space and competing with the title.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce ad chrome around the player, reserve a smaller non-deceptive slot, and keep the primary media/title dominant.

findings.summary: Reusable cards rely only on viewport layout
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules although listing cards are reused in desktop and mobile grids.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable listing/card regions container-type and adapt card internals with @container rules while retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and target sizing are inadequate
findings.evidence: The focus probe found many links with outline none; Lighthouse failed target-size, including 16px-high footer links.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a strong :focus-visible ring and provide at least 24×24 CSS px target area with adequate spacing.

findings.summary: The watch journey does not present a ready media duration
findings.evidence: The representative detail screenshot shows the player at 00:00 / 00:00 despite schema metadata declaring 02:15, while a large ad immediately competes for attention.
findings.suggestedFix: Load media metadata reliably, show a clear playable state/error fallback, and defer adjacent advertising until it cannot obscure the core watch action.

findings.summary: Mobile lab LCP is slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.1s, Speed Index 8.8s and Time to Interactive 12.5s (performance 0.64), although the unthrottled trace observed LCP near 2.0s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce render-blocking/third-party work and validate under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes waste and broken preloads
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 96 requests/1.65MB, five VeryHigh parser stylesheets, duplicate Google Fonts CSS, and 404s for preloaded hero.webp and your-theme/style.css.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove broken/duplicate preloads, consolidate font CSS, and shorten the critical dependency chain.

findings.summary: Substantial unused code ships on the homepage
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 208KiB unused JavaScript and 29KiB unused CSS; GTM alone wastes about 69.6KiB and the theme stylesheet was 83.9% unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load page-specific and advertising scripts, trim theme CSS, and remove duplicate dependencies.

findings.summary: Injected links and frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a full-viewport ad link in the tab order with no name and three injected iframes without titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Require accessible names for links and meaningful iframe titles; make decorative frames presentational and non-focusable.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG minimums
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.32:1 for the homepage help copy and 2.27:1 for green ratings on white, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose darker text/rating colors that meet WCAG AA in every state.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus disappears across navigation
findings.evidence: The active focus probe reports outline none and no box shadow for menu, filter, and category links; the logo link is also unnamed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic labelled controls and a consistent high-contrast :focus-visible treatment without suppressing the browser outline.

findings.summary: Viewport disables user zoom
findings.evidence: The viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=0; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions and enlarge undersized targets.

findings.summary: Broken resources produce console errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged 404 console errors for /wp-content/uploads/hero.webp and /wp-content/themes/your-theme/style.css.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or correct the broken preload/resource URLs and add deployment checks for 4xx static assets.

findings.summary: Image delivery is structurally inefficient
findings.evidence: Image audit found 39/39 legacy PNGs, 35 below-fold images without lazy loading, 31 without srcset, eight oversized, and one image missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, lazy loading below the fold, and AVIF/WebP variants.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 17 deprecation warnings and a subframe unload handler that prevents BFCache restoration.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove/replace third parties using deprecated APIs and unload handlers; verify BFCache after vendor changes.

findings.summary: Sitemap is blocked by Cloudflare
findings.evidence: The homepage has canonical/index robots and robots.txt is reachable, but /sitemap.xml returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge to a plain HTTP client.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow crawler access to the XML sitemap and verify robots/sitemap URLs without a browser challenge.

findings.summary: Baseline security headers and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but headers evidence found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; three first-party cookies were not Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: Extensive opaque advertising and tracking runs by default
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 20 third-party origins, including GA and opaque ad hosts; HAR counted 32 third-party requests/284KB, with a full-viewport unnamed ad link injected into the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove opaque ad chains, allowlist necessary vendors, gate non-essential analytics on informed consent, and minimise retention.

findings.summary: Account UI uses password-only authentication without autofill hints
findings.evidence: The contact-page DOM exposes username/password login and reset forms; no passkey/WebAuthn surface or autocomplete tokens were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct username/current-password autocomplete immediately and offer passkeys/WebAuthn for authentication.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, or general restrictive Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and a nonce/hash CSP.

findings.summary: CSS is not writing-mode resilient
findings.evidence: The document declares lang=en-US, but the CSS probe counted 116 physical left/right declarations and zero logical-property rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace directional spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties and test RTL.

findings.summary: A deceptive full-viewport ad link enters the tab order
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed injected anchor covering 412×823 and targeting kilojaya.com; opaque ad scripts also inject full-page frames.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove popunder/full-viewport ad overlays and ensure every commercial link is visible, labelled and user-initiated.

findings.summary: Forms omit autocomplete assistance
findings.evidence: Contact name/email fields and login username/password fields expose empty autocomplete attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add name, email, username and current-password autocomplete tokens as appropriate.

findings.summary: Account controls lack modern authentication safeguards
findings.evidence: Hidden login/reset forms are password-only and provide neither autocomplete metadata nor visible passkey/reauthentication support.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a clear account surface with passkeys, correct autofill, safe recovery and reauthentication for sensitive changes.

findings.summary: All audited images use legacy PNG delivery
findings.evidence: Images evidence found no modern-format image among 39 assets, 31 missing responsive sources, eight oversized and 35 eager below-fold images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails.

findings.summary: The page performs disproportionate background third-party work
findings.evidence: HAR captured 96 requests and 24 scripts; tracker evidence found 20 third-party origins before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or remove background analytics/ad fetches and load optional vendors only after explicit need/consent.

findings.summary: Third-party and media cost is disproportionate
findings.evidence: The 1.65MB homepage includes 284KB across 32 third-party requests, 121KB of fonts, and 981KB of mostly eager PNG images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set page/third-party budgets, self-host/subset fonts, optimize thumbnails, and enforce vendor byte/request caps.
